title: Evaluate selected PR1094 final-stage replay on native Windows
body:
The selected PR1094 final-stage entry point rejects native Windows relative-path keys before creating output. This separate, source-pinned successor applies only PR2316's two documented `.as_posix()` substitutions in memory and completes all eleven inherited strict stages, retaining every original assertion and source guard.

Every one of the 105 output files is compared against the reviewed PR1094 archive. On Windows, 88 files (all 22 gzip outputs included) are byte-identical; the remaining differences are explicitly checked log line endings, invoice JSON key order, six relocated input-path keys, and the corresponding verified receipt hash links and stage timings. The assembly is value-equivalent under those documented dependency checks, not byte-identical. No blanket hash or volatile-field exclusions are used.

Validation on Windows 11 / CPython 3.12.14:
- Package metadata and immutable source pins pass.
- Complete registered replay passes under an optimized parent; the successor compiles with `optimize=0` and strict children retain assertions.
- All 16 deliberate corruptions are rejected, including proof-value/type changes, duplicate invoice keys, wrong digest links, altered logs, missing/extra files, changed gzip output and a changed original script.
- `git diff --cached --check` passed before commit.

Scope: ten authenticated archived PR1042 local inputs; selected final stage only. No cold ancestry, Linux execution, new kappa, full-theorem verification, frozen-source edits or selected-frontier change is claimed. Maintainer adoption of a portable selected entry point remains open.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2333
Predecessor: #2316 at `1b732744b66cc3461559d52349ae07fa31d444f8`; this completes its requested successor-execution handoff. Also credits JosieElliston's macOS final-stage portability audit, Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Douglas Colkitt and the retained source lineage. Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (priority revision 4).

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in investigation, implementation, execution, self-review and writing; no independent human review claimed. New work is Apache-2.0. Exact pins, execution receipt, limitations and actionable next questions are in the package.
